translations.web: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.
translations.bsb: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.
translations.kjv: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace
translations.asv: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field; And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
